verdict.rationale: Paddle documents payout reconciliation reports that tie each payout to its underlying transactions and adjustments. The reports itemize gross, taxes, Paddle fees, chargebacks and retained fees in both transaction and balance currencies, and payout totals can be verified against remittance advice, available via the API. Nothing in the evidence shows a finance-ops user can control payout timing or frequency, so only half the story is delivered. Missing for 10: payout schedule control (timing/frequency/thresholds), explicit itemization of refunds beyond generic 'adjustments', and independent or hands-on corroboration of the reports.
